verdict.rationale: Requesty's analytics dashboard shows usage metrics such as costs, tokens and latency, but nothing indicates the product generates AI insights or suggestions from that data. Its PDF analysis, image understanding and prompt optimization features are model-routing building blocks or adjacent features, not in-product AI insights. Since an LLM gateway could plausibly offer AI-driven usage or cost recommendations, the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
